summary: The change adds a closed four-value receipt-failure detail, exports it on the matrix cell result, passes it through trusted ingestion, and prefers it in the persisted park blocker while keeping attempt memory and repeat-failure normalization on the historical generic identity. The added tests cover failed, interrupted, host-timeout, dirty-tree, loop-stop, legacy-null and untrusted-detail inputs.

evidence: `src/repair/attempt-policy.ts` lines 63-85 define the four closed details and derive them from receipt outcome, terminal origin and the explicit dirty-tree error without copying raw runtime text.
`src/host/matrix-cell.ts` line 338 exports the detail on the cell result; `src/host/matrix-ingest.ts` lines 412-420 pass it to `handleModelReceipt`.
`src/repair/loop-implementation-result.ts` lines 208-220 prefer a recognized closed detail in the park blocker while keeping the generic `incompleteMessage` for attempt memory.

`ops/hosted-autonomy-repeat-failure.ts` lines 90-102 normalize the new closed details back to the historical generic identity so repeat-failure gates and signatures do not change; `tests/host/matrix-terminal-failure-detail_test.ts` covers all four causes plus legacy and untrusted detail cases.
